title: Doritos=diorite
description: me leaving school when my friend says "do you call diorite Doritos?
body:
I made this cause when i was leaving  school my friend said oh do you call diorite doritos so i had the thought ot just make dorito/diorite resource pack. this is my first time making a resource pack so this was fun since i had no idea what i was doing. 

p.s. i did not make the item names change to say Doritos though i am pretty sure  it can be done so it might happen if i decide to update this pack
